title: Four Into One, Re-drawn
summary: This is the round-1 'Four Into One' section you picked, kept as it was except for the centre animation: the nested boxes are gone. In their place, four loose clouds of points, one beside each number, flow together into a single field of 100 points (four into one). The field then fills to each reading in turn (17 → 95:5 → 77 → 53), like a bar you can count, in step with its big number.

reference.site: Round 1 · A (Four Into One) + C's drafting precision
reference.borrowed: From round-1 A, everything except the centre figure: the paper act, the 'Four numbers. / One diagnosis.' head, the 2×2 of big numerals on a hairline cross, the named sources, the numerals counting up once, and the FIG. 03 caption band with one control. From the AI in Design Report reference behind A, the idea of a chart with no axes that draws each value as a quantity inside one unit. From C, how the figure is drawn: registration marks at the frame corners, a knock-out that stops the hairline cross at the frame, and a legend swatch.
reference.kelwin: The figure is now the FIELD primitive (DIRECTION-AC P3) in place of nested squares. It has 100 points of 6px on a 10×10 lattice at a 32px pitch, so 1 point = 1 in 100, and sits in a 384px registration frame on the crossing (cols 5–8). The points start as four loose clouds, one beside each reading, and converge into one lattice, which is the section's 'four numbers, one diagnosis' argument made visible. A reading lights its share column by column from the left, like a bar, and the last part-column fills from its centre out. So 17 reads as one full column of ten plus seven, and no share can form a corner, a step or a nest. The red belongs only to the 17-point subset, the share of the journey that sales owns. 95, 77 and 53 light in ink, and the remainder stays light grey. The control names the four readings (17% · 95:5 · 77% · 53%). The legend in the band reads '■ 17 of 100 · journey time with sales', with the swatch following the state's colour. The active numeral cell takes a 1px ink top rule, drawn from its left edge.

addressed: The nested-box animation in the centre is gone. No square sits inside another, nothing is stacked into a corner, and nothing in the section echoes the logo symbol.

The new animation is a field of 100 small points, where 1 point = 1 in 100. It starts as four loose clouds, one beside each number, which flow together into one calm 10×10 grid. That is 'four numbers, one diagnosis' happening on screen, so the section keeps the idea you liked.

The grid then fills to each number in turn (17 → 95:5 → 77 → 53), column by column from the left like a bar you can count. The matching big number gets a thin dark rule above it and the legend in the band names the reading, so you always know which one the field is showing. It comes back to rest on the 17.
The 17 is the one red moment: one full column of ten plus seven, sitting right beside the 17% it measures. The other readings fill in black, so red never gets scattered around the figure.

Everything else is kept as you liked it: the four big numbers counting up, their sources, the hairline cross and the FIG. 03 band. Only the polish changed to fit the blended system: the shared head style, the 176px numerals, tidier mono labels, and a control in the band that lets you pick any of the four readings.
motion: entrance (kit choreography): the label fades in. 'Four numbers.' then the light 'One diagnosis.' rise out of their masks. The 48×2 red rule draws and the lede fades up 12px. The plate's top rule, centre hairline and vertical draw from their origins (380–1500ms). The four readings fade up in reading order (90ms apart). The numerals count up once from 00 (700ms delay, 1.2s, tabular), and the ':5' of 95:5 lands with its count. The band fades in at 900ms, and the four registration marks fade in at the frame corners (760–940ms).

orchestrated moment (FIELD · scatter resolves into order, as four into one): 100 points fade in as four loose seeded clouds, one beside each reading, in reading order 01 → 04 (380–720ms, --fg-3). Each cloud holds every other point of the lattice in both directions, so the four weave together. From 760ms each point travels to its lattice target over 1200ms with --ease-inout (JS rAF, a cubic-bezier solve), swept from the top-left (01) to the bottom-right (04) with a 0–360ms stagger. Each point latches as it lands (200ms): grey for the remainder, red if it belongs to the 17. Cell 01's top rule draws at 1.5s, and the last point lands at about 2.3s.

stepped readings: at 2.45s, 3.4s and 4.35s the field changes to 95:5, then 77, then 53. Each change behaves like a bar, extending rightwards from the old edge or retracting back to the new one at 30ms per column, with a 360ms fill crossfade. The active cell's ink top rule, the legend line (which fades out, then in, so two lines never overlap) and the control move with it. At 5.3s the field retracts to 01 · 17, the red arriving as the retraction reaches the first column. Everything is settled by about 5.9s.

interaction: the 17% · 95:5 · 77% · 53% control really switches the field, with the same extend or retract. A click during the entrance lands every point at once and stops the automatic stepping. The kit hover applies on the control.

on the live site: the figure plays once when it is 40% visible (IntersectionObserver, no pin). It auto-steps 01 → 04 every 1.4s while in view, returns to 01 and stops; the first click stops it for good. There is no ambient loop. Reduced motion renders the final markup synchronously, which is the lattice with the 17 in red, cell 01 ruled and the control on 17%, and starts no timers.
notes: The stage is 1393px tall. It has 128px section padding top and bottom (kit .ac-sec), the kit head (88px statement), a plate 64px below the head, two reading rows, and a 72px band. To stay under the 1400px ceiling, the cells are 4px tighter than round 1 and the numeral line box is trimmed to .8 (176px, the kit size). The field frame is 384px, centred on the crossing; the lattice is 294px on whole pixels, so the 6px points render crisp. The hairline cross is knocked out inside the frame, which keeps the field reading as one unit. Ranks run column by column, and within a column from the centre row outwards, so every share is a contiguous left-anchored mass whose ragged end is centred. That rules out corner notches and staircases at every value. The demo compresses the live 1.4s step to 0.95s so the whole sequence fits in 6s. C quotas: 1 drawing, 0 callouts, 0 dimension lines, 4 registration marks, 0 title blocks (the band's FIG. caption does that job), and mono lines of 36 characters or fewer, none of them a sentence. The clouds are seeded (mulberry32), so every render is identical. Points were tested at 8px: they gained presence, but the grey remainder turned into a tiled pattern, so they stay at the P3 spec of 6px.
